! =====================================================
! BASIC / IDENTITY
! =====================================================
hostname [SW-ACCESS-01]
!
no ip domain lookup
ip domain name [example.local]
!
no service pad
no service config
no ip source-route
no ip gratuitous-arps
ip dhcp bootp ignore
no vstack
service tcp-keepalives-in
service tcp-keepalives-out

! =====================================================
! AAA — Cisco ISE (TACACS+) z lokalnym fallbackiem (break-glass only)
! =====================================================
username [breakglass-admin] privilege 15 algorithm-type scrypt secret [STRONG_SECRET]
enable algorithm-type scrypt secret [ENABLE_SECRET]
!
aaa new-model
!
tacacs server [ISE-1]
 address ipv4 [10.x.x.x]
 key [TACACS_SHARED_SECRET]
 timeout 5
!
aaa group server tacacs+ [ISE-TACACS]
 server name [ISE-1]
!
aaa authentication login default group [ISE-TACACS] local
aaa authentication enable default group [ISE-TACACS] enable
aaa authorization exec default group [ISE-TACACS] local if-authenticated
aaa authorization commands 15 default group [ISE-TACACS] local if-authenticated
aaa authorization console
aaa accounting exec default start-stop group [ISE-TACACS]
aaa accounting commands 15 default start-stop group [ISE-TACACS]
aaa accounting connection default start-stop group [ISE-TACACS]
aaa accounting system default start-stop group [ISE-TACACS]
!
login block-for 120 attempts 3 within 60
login quiet-mode access-class [MGMT-ACL]
login on-failure log
login on-success log
!
! =====================================================
! MANAGEMENT — SSH only, VRF MGMT, ograniczenie źródeł
! =====================================================
vrf definition [MGMT]
 address-family ipv4
 exit-address-family
!
interface Vlan[100]
 description MGMT
 vrf forwarding [MGMT]
 ip address [10.100.0.10] [255.255.255.0]
 no shutdown
!
ip route vrf [MGMT] 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 [10.100.0.1]
!
ip access-list standard [MGMT-ACL]
 permit [10.100.0.0] [0.0.0.255]
 deny   any log
!
crypto key generate rsa modulus 4096
ip ssh version 2
ip ssh time-out 60
ip ssh authentication-retries 3
ip ssh dh min size 4096
ip ssh server algorithm encryption aes256-gcm@openssh.com aes256-ctr
ip ssh server algorithm mac hmac-sha2-512 hmac-sha2-256
ip ssh server algorithm kex ecdh-sha2-nistp384 ecdh-sha2-nistp256
ip ssh source-interface Vlan[100]
ip ssh logging events
!
line vty 0 15
 transport input ssh
 transport output ssh
 access-class [MGMT-ACL] in vrf-also
 exec-timeout 5 0
 session-timeout 15
 logging synchronous
!
line con 0
 exec-timeout 5 0
 logging synchronous
!
line aux 0
 no exec
 transport input none
!
no ip http server
no ip http secure-server
!
! =====================================================
! NTP — CORE SW jako źródło czasu, z uwierzytelnianiem
! =====================================================
ntp authentication-key 1 hmac-sha2-256 [NTP_KEY]
ntp authenticate
ntp trusted-key 1
ntp server [CORE_SW_IP_1] key 1 prefer
ntp server [CORE_SW_IP_2] key 1
clock timezone [UTC] 0
!
! =====================================================
! LOGGING — syslog + audyt zmian konfiguracji
! =====================================================
logging buffered 512000 informational
logging host [LOG_SYSTEM_IP] vrf [MGMT]
logging source-interface Vlan[100] vrf [MGMT]
logging trap informational
no logging console
service timestamps log datetime msec localtime show-timezone
service timestamps debug datetime msec localtime show-timezone
service sequence-numbers
!
archive
 log config
  logging enable
  logging size 500
  notify syslog contenttype plaintext
  hidekeys
!
! SNMPv3 zamiast community v2c
no snmp-server community [RO_COMMUNITY]
snmp-server group [SNMPV3-GROUP] v3 priv read [SNMPV3-VIEW] access [SNMP_ACL]
snmp-server view [SNMPV3-VIEW] iso included
snmp-server user [SNMPV3-USER] [SNMPV3-GROUP] v3 auth sha [AUTH_PASS] priv aes 256 [PRIV_PASS] access [SNMP_ACL]
snmp-server location [BUILDING/FLOOR/ROOM]
snmp-server contact [NETOPS_CONTACT]
snmp-server enable traps snmp authentication linkdown linkup coldstart warmstart
!

! =====================================================
! GLOBAL L2 SECURITY
! =====================================================
spanning-tree mode rapid-pvst
spanning-tree portfast bpduguard default
spanning-tree extend system-id
!
ip dhcp snooping
ip dhcp snooping vlan [10,20,30]
no ip dhcp snooping information option
!
ip arp inspection vlan [10,20,30]
ip arp inspection validate src-mac dst-mac ip
!
udld enable
!
errdisable recovery cause bpduguard
errdisable recovery cause psecure-violation
errdisable recovery cause arp-inspection
errdisable recovery interval 300
!
vtp mode transparent
!
! =====================================================
! ACCESS PORTS — userzy + telefony (PoE)
! =====================================================
interface range GigabitEthernet1/0/1 - 40
 description [USER+PHONE]
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan [10]
 switchport voice vlan [20]
 switchport port-security maximum 3
 switchport port-security violation restrict
 switchport port-security aging time 5
 switchport port-security aging type inactivity
 switchport port-security
 ip verify source
 spanning-tree portfast
 spanning-tree guard root
 storm-control broadcast level 5.00
 storm-control multicast level 10.00
 storm-control action trap
!
! ACCESS PORTS — Access Pointy
interface range GigabitEthernet1/0/41 - 46
 description [WIFI-AP]
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan [30]
 spanning-tree portfast
 spanning-tree guard root
!
! Nieużywane porty — shutdown + blackhole VLAN
interface range GigabitEthernet1/0/47 - 48
 description UNUSED
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan [999]
 switchport port-security
 no cdp enable
 no lldp transmit
 no lldp receive
 shutdown
!

! UPLINK — trunk do dystrybucji (C9500)

 switchport trunk allowed vlan [10,20,30,100]
 switchport trunk native vlan [999]

 ip dhcp snooping trust
 ip arp inspection trust
 udld port aggressive
 channel-group 1 mode active
!
interface Port-channel1
 description PO1-UPLINK-[DISTRO-SW]
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport trunk allowed vlan [10,20,30,100]
 switchport trunk native vlan [999]
!
